terms.definitionEn: An element that creates a hyperlink to another location or resource.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيعمل رابط لمكان تاني أو لمورد خارجي.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute that supplies the destination URL for a hyperlink.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد عنوان الوجهة اللي الرابط هيفتحها.

terms.definitionEn: A void element that embeds an image resource in the page.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر من غير وسم إغلاق بيعرض صورة جوه الصفحة.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute that gives the URL of an embedded resource such as an image.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد عنوان المورد اللي بيتعرض جوه الصفحة زي الصورة.

terms.definitionEn: Words that convey relevant information when an image cannot be seen.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتوفر وصف نصي بديل للصورة حسب دورها في الصفحة.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute selecting the browsing context where a hyperlink opens.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتحدد نافذة أو لسان المتصفح اللي الرابط هيفتح فيه.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute describing how a hyperlink is connected to its destination.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتوضح العلاقة بين الرابط والصفحة اللي بيروح لها.

terms.definitionEn: An attribute listing image candidates that a browser can select for different conditions.
terms.definitionAr: خاصية بتعرض اختيارات صور يقدر المتصفح ينتقي منها حسب ظروف العرض.

terms.definitionEn: A self-contained visual unit such as an image, often paired with a caption.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر لمحتوى بصري مستقل زي صورة وممكن يكون معاه تعليق.

terms.definitionEn: An element that provides a caption for its parent figure.
terms.definitionAr: عنصر بيضيف تعليق أو وصف للشكل الموجود في figure.

terms.definitionEn: An address resolved from the current document's location rather than from a full origin.
terms.definitionAr: عنوان بيتحدد بالنسبة لمكان المستند الحالي بدل ما يكتب عنوان الموقع كامل.

terms.definitionEn: A complete URL that includes a scheme and host for identifying a resource.
terms.definitionAr: عنوان كامل فيه البروتوكول واسم الموقع عشان يحدد المورد بوضوح.

questions.question: What happens when a visitor activates this element?
options: The browser follows a hyperlink to /workshops
The browser downloads an image named workshops
The page submits an empty form
The text is announced as a heading only
questions.explanation: An anchor with href creates a hyperlink to its destination.
questions.explanationAr: عنصر a مع href بيعمل رابط للوجهة المحددة.

questions.question: Which attribute gives the destination of this hyperlink?
options: The alt attribute
The href attribute
The target attribute
The rel attribute
questions.explanation: href contains the URL the hyperlink points to.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية href فيها عنوان الوجهة اللي الرابط بيشير لها.

options: Read the field guide /guide.
Read the /guide field guide.
Read the field guide.
No visible text
questions.explanation: The link text is visible; the href value is not displayed as page text.
questions.explanationAr: نص الرابط ظاهر، لكن قيمة href مش بتتعرض كنص.

questions.prompt: Make the word Help link to the help page.
questions.explanation: href supplies a hyperlink's destination.

questions.question: What does the alt value provide?
options: A text alternative describing the image
A second image file to load at high density
The URL opened when the image is clicked
A caption printed below the image
questions.explanation: alt supplies alternative text for the image; it is not automatically a visible caption.
questions.explanationAr: خاصية alt بتوفر نص بديل للصورة ومش تعليق ظاهر تحتها.

questions.prompt: Provide a short text alternative for the picture.
questions.explanation: The alt attribute gives an image a text alternative.

questions.question: Why does img not have a closing tag here?
options: Every image is closed by the browser's next paragraph
The alt attribute closes the element automatically
HTML permits closing tags only inside links
img is a void element and has no end tag
questions.explanation: img is a void element, so it must not have a closing tag.
questions.explanationAr: img عنصر void ومش بيستخدم وسم إغلاق.

questions.expectedOutput: The North club logo is shown.
questions.explanation: The paragraph's text is visible independently of an image alternative.

questions.prompt: Open the destination in a new browsing context.
questions.explanation: target="_blank" requests a new browsing context for the linked destination.

questions.question: What relationship hint does rel="noopener" provide for this new tab?
options: It guarantees that the remote page cannot load images or change the page visual styles
It blocks opener access in the newly opened context
It changes the link into a same-origin URL
It makes the browser reuse the current tab
questions.explanation: noopener prevents the opened browsing context from gaining access through window.opener.
questions.explanationAr: noopener بيمنع الصفحة المفتوحة من الوصول للصفحة الأصلية عن طريق window.opener.

questions.prompt: Add the relationship token that isolates a newly opened page from window.opener.
questions.explanation: The rel attribute records the relationship token noopener.

options: Fern frond\nFound near the creek
fern.jpg\nFound near the creek
Found near the creek
No visible text
questions.explanation: The caption is visible text; alternative text is not normally shown when the image loads.

questions.question: How can the browser use this srcset value?
options: Use both candidates at once to combine their pixels into one larger image
Treat 2x as the image's alternative text
Replace the image with a hyperlink
Choose an image candidate based on display conditions
questions.explanation: srcset lists image candidates and descriptors that help the browser choose an appropriate resource.
questions.explanationAr: srcset بيعرض صور بديلة ووصفها عشان المتصفح يختار المورد المناسب.

questions.prompt: Offer a higher-density image candidate in addition to the fallback src.
questions.explanation: srcset provides image candidates with descriptors for browser selection.
The caption is visible text associated with the figure; alt is not normally displayed when the image loads.

questions.prompt: Add a caption to the figure containing the image.
questions.explanation: figcaption labels or describes the contents of its parent figure.

questions.question: Why include both relationship tokens on a link opened in a new tab?
options: noopener blocks opener access; noreferrer also omits referrer data
They keep the browser from sending cookies or any credentials to the destination
They force the destination into a secure browsing mode
They prevent every script from running on the destination
questions.explanation: noopener prevents access through window.opener; noreferrer also omits the referrer header.
questions.explanationAr: noopener بيعزل window.opener، وnoreferrer كمان بيمنع إرسال معلومات الصفحة المحيلة.

questions.prompt: Use a parent-directory relative path to link to the shared guide.
questions.explanation: A relative URL is resolved from the current document's location.

questions.question: When is an empty alt value appropriate?
options: Whenever the image file is larger than 100 kilobytes
When the image adds no unique information beyond nearby content
When the image is a link whose destination has no URL
For any image needing a screen-reader description, since empty alt requests automatic text
questions.explanation: An empty alt value can mark a decorative image so it does not add redundant information to the accessibility tree.
questions.explanationAr: alt الفاضي مناسب للصورة الزخرفية عشان ما يكررش معلومة موجودة.

questions.prompt: Supply an image candidate for a device pixel density of two.
questions.explanation: A 2x density descriptor identifies a candidate for a higher pixel density.

questions.question: How do src and alt serve different purposes on an image?
keyPoints: src identifies the image resource URL
Alternative text should convey relevant image information
Decorative images may use an empty alt value
questions.modelAnswer: src identifies the resource the browser should load. alt provides a textual alternative for users who cannot see the image, or can be empty when a decorative image adds no information.

questions.question: What is the difference between an absolute URL and a relative URL in a link?
keyPoints: An absolute URL includes its scheme and host
A relative URL is resolved from the current document location
Relative paths can use directory segments
Choose based on whether the destination is local or external
questions.modelAnswer: An absolute URL identifies a resource with a complete address, including its scheme and host. A relative URL is resolved from the current document's location and is often useful for resources within the same site.

questions.question: What security and privacy considerations apply when a link opens a new tab?
keyPoints: Use the relationship tokens for the intended protection
questions.modelAnswer: A new browsing context should not be able to control its opener, so noopener is useful protection. noreferrer additionally omits referrer information, which can be appropriate for privacy.

questions.question: How can srcset help browsers select images for different screens?
keyPoints: The browser chooses a candidate for the display conditions
A suitable src fallback remains useful
questions.modelAnswer: srcset lets a page list image candidates with descriptors such as pixel density or width. The browser can choose a suitable resource for the display conditions, with src providing a useful fallback.
